neighbours.label: stating a methodological gap in research writing: a needed method was lacking, hard, or challenging ('a reliable technique ... was lacking', 'difficult to test', 'a challenging task')
fire: For decades, a reliable method for dating these fossils was lacking.
Measuring the flow inside tiny vessels has been a difficult task.
The hypothesis was hard to test because the enzyme breaks down quickly.
Until recently, no efficient protocol existed to grow these cells.
Tracking single molecules in living tissue remains a challenging problem.
Studies were limited by the lack of a sensitive assay for the hormone.
Imaging the deep ocean floor has long been a technically demanding task.
A practical way to label the neurons in adult mice was still missing.
quiet: For decades, scientists have dated these fossils with a standard method.
The team measured the flow inside tiny vessels using dye.
The hypothesis was tested in three labs with the same enzyme.
The lab grew these cells using a well-known protocol.
The group tracked single molecules in living tissue last year.
The study measured the hormone with a sensitive assay.
The ship imaged the deep ocean floor during a two-week cruise.
The neurons in adult mice were labelled with a green dye.

predictions: fire 0.1-0.3 on the gap phrase; the same research described as done routinely below 0.03
notes: Probe (weak): 'technique ... was lacking' 0.287, 'challenging task' 0.139, 'difficult to test' 0.107, 'lack of efficient protocols' 0.085; routine-method rewrites 0.007-0.014. Best guess; the pole is weak on probes.
